parsed.rationale: V1-V3 show deep S waves with concave ST elevation and upright T waves with no reciprocal inferior or lateral ST depression, which fits an LVH voltage/strain pattern rather than an acute occlusion MI, so I do not read this as STEMI (the limb leads are noisy, so this is less certain).
